batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c MA Agarwal b Fazalhaq Farooqi

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c Abhishek Sharma b T Natarajan

batting.name: R Parag
batting.dismissal: c Fazalhaq Farooqi b T Natarajan

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b YS Chahal

batting.name: RA Tripathi
batting.dismissal: c JO Holder b TA Boult

batting.name: Washington Sundar
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b JO Holder

batting.name: GD Phillips
batting.dismissal: c KM Asif b R Ashwin

batting.name: AU Rashid
batting.dismissal: st SV Samson b YS Chahal

balls.text: full delivery way outside off stump. Hetmyer hangs back in his crease and flicks it towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
in the slot and he gets dispatched! Just outside off stump, and Hetmyer winds up before banging it over the bowler's head for four!
very full delivery outside off stump. Hetmyer opens his bat face and glides it towards deep point. Hetmyer and Ashwin hare back for the second and eventually make it
another top yorker outside off stump. Hetmyer can't get under this one too and scuffs it back to the bowler

is that out? Another sizzling wide yorker outside off stump. Hetmyer dangles his bat, looking to guide it past short third man but might have gotten too thin a tickle. Phillips gobbles up the chance but the only question is whether it is a bump ball. The third umpire has been called into question, and replays say that the ball bounced after hitting the bat!
full delivery outside off stump. Hetmyer sits deep in his crease and drags it towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
angled into the pads. Hetmyer turns it behind square on the leg side and is content with a single
low full toss on middle and off stump. Ashwin backs away and slices it towards backward point for a single. A wild throw by Sundar that nearly reaches long on on the full but no damage done

oh dear, that has gone through! Off-pace delivery on a length outside off stump. Ashwin is completely deceived and can't lay bat on it. But the keeper can't gather either, with the ball bouncing in front of him and bobbling away to the fence

taken brilliantly at deep mid wicket! Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump, and this one just sticks in the surface a little. Samson has a swipe at it but is early into the stroke. He shanks it towards deep mid wicket, where Abhishek settles himself, catches it and then tiptoes his way out of trouble beautifully!
low full toss just outside off stump. Hetmyer winds up and powers it down the ground towards long off for just another single
oh dear! Yorker just outside off stump. Hetmyer squeezes it out towards extra cover and sets off for the single, only to see his partner stationary. Sundar has a shy at the stumps but misses
full and down the leg side. Samson knows that fine leg is up in the circle and just glances it neatly past that fielder to pick up a much-needed boundary!
full delivery outside off stump. Hetmyer reaches out for it and drives it down the ground for just another single
wide yorker nailed to perception. Hetmyer leaves it alone but acknowledges that the ball snuck just inside the tramlines
big shot! Banged into the track on middle and leg stump. Hetmyer picks up the length early and dumps it a mile over the deep mid wicket fence!
very full delivery on leg stump. Samson gives himself a bit of room but can only dig it out towards extra cover for one more run
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Hetmyer frees his arms and cuts it towards deep point for a single
low full toss outside off stump. Samson throws his hands at it but can only slice it towards backward point
another good yorker on middle and leg stump. Hetmyer works it towards deep mid wicket and collects a single
slower delivery on a length just outside off stump. Hetmyer comes forward and pokes it back to the bowler
length delivery outside off stump. Samson comes forward and punches it towards extra cover for a single. Brings up a 28-ball fifty too!
yorker on leg stump. Hetmyer comes forward and tucks it off his toes towards deep square leg to get off the mark

taken at short third man! Natarajan gets Parag! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Parag has a hack across the line but the angle means that he always has to fetch it. The ball also gets a little big on him and he ends up top-edging it towards short third man, where Farooqi settles under the high ball and completes the catch!
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Parag turns it into the leg side for another easy single
quicker and flatter outside off stump. Samson goes deep into his crease and dabs it down to short third man for one
is that a drop? Flighted on a full length outside off stump. Samson looks to go downtown but loses his shape, shanking it towards mid wicket, where Farooqi puts down a tough chance to his right
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Parag pushes it down the ground and ambles across to the other end
slower and wider outside off stump. Samson reaches out for it and drives it towards deep cover point
what a shot! Tossed up into the slot outside off stump. Samson plants his front foot and creams it a mile over the long off fence!
full delivery on leg stump. Samson uses the pace and tucks it off the pads towards deep backward square leg
full delivery on middle and off stump. Parag comes half forward and knocks it down the ground for a single
short delivery outside off stump. Samson gets up on his toes and cuts it down to third man for a single
back of a length delivery that slides down the leg side. Samson does not get bat on it as the keeper comes around and collects. Called a wide. That was clocked at 152.1 kph, btw!
back of a length delivery outside off stump that jags back and cuts Parag in half. He is late on the pull and swipes at thin air. Phillips fumbles too, and RR get a single
and he gets off the mark in style! Short and wide outside off stump. Parag throws his hands at it and carves it over extra cover for four!

cleans him up with a corker! Heat-seeking 149.2 kph missile that hones in on off stump. Padikkal is already hanging back because of the extra pace and is awfully late on the stroke. He jumps up into the air but cannot do anything as the ball whistles past the bat and sends off stump flying!
full delivery on middle and off stump. Padikkal knocks it down the ground and collects another run
back of a length delivery outside off stump again. Samson gets on top of the bounce and jabs it towards deep cover point for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump. Samson waits in his crease and cuts it straight to the fielder at backward point
full delivery on middle and off stump. Padikkal lunges forward and pushes it towards long off for a single
length delivery on off stump. Samson tries to repeat the stroke but is cramped for room, instead punching it towards long on for one
dragged down outside off stump, and that is poor from Sundar. Samson rocks back and flat-bats it over long off for a maximum!
excellent yorker on middle and leg stump. Padikkal jams his bat down in time and digs it out towards the bowler
low full toss outside off stump. Samson opens the bat face and guides it past backward point for a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Padikkal is late on the stroke as the ball pings off the thigh pad into the on side for a leg bye

holes out to deep square leg! Farooqi has another!  Banged into the track on middle and off stump. Jaiswal looks to heave it away but does not quite get hold of it. In fact, he toe-ends it and Mayank does the rest on the fence! Vital wicket for SRH!

did that carry? Length delivery outside off stump that might have nipped back just a shade. Jaiswal has a waft at it and gets an inside edge that floats through to Phillips. He dives forward and picks it up but is unsure if he has done so on the full. Looks like it has clearly bounced, and Jaiswal survives!
shot! Full and slanted into leg stump. Jaiswal backs away very early and drills it between extra cover and mid off for four!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Samson camps in his crease and cuts it towards backward point
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Jaiswal works it towards deep mid wicket and gets to his fifty, off 34 balls!
back of a length delivery outside off stump that grips and spins away. Jaiswal has a swish across the line and is beaten all ends up
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal jabs it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Samson goes back and pulls it down the ground towards long on for a single
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Jaiswal stabs it into the leg side and gets across to the other end
full delivery on middle and off stump. Jaiswal lunges forward and turns it towards deep mid wicket for one
slider on a length outside off stump. Jaiswal goes feeling for it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
length delivery just outside off stump. Samson waits for the ball to arrive before dabbing it down to short third man for a single
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Jaiswal gets to the pitch of the ball and works it towards deep mid wicket for one
full delivery just outside off stump. Samson comes forward and pushes it down the ground for a single
into the stands! Dragged down on leg stump and that is easy pickings for Samson! He rocks back and hammers it over deep mid wicket!
back of a length delivery outside off stump that whistles through. Jaiswal has a waft at it but is late on the stroke, and misses
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Samson dabs it towards deep backward point for a single
top edge, and it flies for six! Sharp bumper and Samson is tucked up. He can't free his arms and swipes at it, getting a top edge that clears the fence over the keeper's head comfortably
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Jaiswal is cramped for room but manages to nudge it into the leg side for a single
length delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal has a go at it but can only scuff it down the ground towards mid off
shot! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jaiswal stands up tall and cracks it past extra cover for another boundary!
tossed up on a length outside off stump. Jaiswal has a waft at it and gets an under edge that ends up nutmegging Phillips. Very difficult to term that a chance!
flatter and fuller on leg stump. Samson opts to stay back before patting it into the leg side for a single
slowed up even more on a length outside off stump. Samson hangs back and cuts it towards deep point for a couple of runs
length delivery given plenty of air just outside off stump. Samson has a nibble at it and sees the ball rip past the outside edge
slowed up on a length on leg stump. Jaiswal works it into the leg side. He wants the second too but is sent back by Samson
short delivery on middle and off stump. Jaiswal cuts again but this time, can't split the gap between backward point and short third man
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jaiswal goes back and eases it towards deep point for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Samson gets up on his toes and runs it down to third man for a single
four more! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Samson watches the ball like a hawk, opens his bat face and glides it past third man
shot! Banged into the track on middle and leg stump. Samson arches his back, gets under it and upper cuts it over the keeper's head for four!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Jaiswal uses the pace and helps it down to fine leg for one more run
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Samson gets inside the line of the ball and glances it down to fine leg for a single
short, wide and punished! Too short and it gives Jaiswal enough time to rock back, get his hands through the ball and knife it past backward point!
googly on a length on middle and off stump. Samson reads it off the surface and turns it into the leg side to get off the mark
shortish on middle and leg stump again. Jaiswal hangs back and knocks it down the ground for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jaiswal can't beat the fielder at short extra cover this time
googly on a back of a length outside off stump. Jaiswal waits in his crease and cuts it towards backward point. The fielder misfields but no damage done
length delivery on middle and off stump. Jaiswal goes back and punches it towards long on for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Samson gets up on his toes and meets it right under his eyes

cleans him up! Farooqi breaks through! Back of a length delivery at the stumps that skids through and might have just nipped back a shade. Buttler tries to punch on the up but the movement means that he gets a feather of an inside edge that cannons into the top of middle and off stump! Much-needed respite for the Sunrisers Hyderabad!
low full toss just outside off stump. Buttler leans forward, opens his bat face just enough and times it exquisitely past mid off for four!
normal service resumes! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Buttler slashes at it and gets it past the keeper. Brings up his fifty too, off just 20 balls!
slower yorker just outside off stump. Buttler can't quite pick it and swings too early, swinging all over it eventually. Rare dot ball!
four more! Slower delivery dug into the track on leg stump. Buttler has all the time in the world to roll his wrists and pull it past deep square leg!
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Buttler has a swing at it and chunks it via a combination of inside edge and thigh pad for a single
four fours in the over! Slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Buttler gets on top of the bounce again and crashes it past extra cover
this is carnage! Short, and offering that amount of width is always dangerous. Buttler sits back in his crease and threads it past backward point!
four more! Full and wide outside off stump. Buttler throws his hands at it and slices it over cover point for another boundary!
length delivery angled across outside off stump. Buttler has a huge swish at it and for a change, makes no contact
change of bowler but no change in result! Length delivery on middle and off stump. Buttler stands tall on the front foot and punches it past mid off for four!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Jaiswal goes back and punches it past extra cover for a couple of runs. Excellent effort by Brook running around from long off
Jaiswal continues on his merry way! Full delivery on middle and off stump. Jaiswal walks across his stumps and sweeps it over backward square leg for four!
tossed up on a full length outside off stump. Buttler plants his front foot and heaves it on the bounce to deep mid wicket. Could the fielder have gone for the catch?
back of a length delivery on off stump. Buttler gets onto the back foot and cuts it straight to short extra cover
another short delivery on off stump, and it goes the distance! Buttler hangs back in his crease and mauls it over cow corner!
and he gets greeted with six! Dragged down outside off stump. Buttler has all the time in the world to rock back and deposit it into the stands over mid wicket
back of a length delivery pushed across the batter outside off stump. Jaiswal has a waft at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
oh dear! Slower bumper on leg stump. Jaiswal creates room for himself and upper cuts it towards short third man. Umran escorts it to the fence and then fails in his attempt to pull it back!
four more! Slower delivery on a full length on middle and leg stump. Jaiswal plants his front foot, gets his wrists into play and flicks it beautifully past mid wicket!
length delivery on off stump. Buttler times it superbly towards mid off, where Sundar misfields again and concedes a single
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Buttler comes half forward and pushes it towards mid off, where the fielder misfields and allows the second
shot! Full and slanted into middle and leg stump. Buttler plants his front foot and nonchalantly clips it well over the deep mid wicket fence!
back of a length delivery outside off stump that hurries onto the batter. Jaiswal has another hack at it but this time, jams it off the inside edge into his pads
banged into the track outside off stump. Jaiswal has a swipe at it and while he miscues it, he gets enough wood to clear mid on and collect a boundary!
gets off the mark! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Buttler lets the ball come to him before tucking it neatly past square leg. Gets back for three!
full delivery outside off stump. Jaiswal comes onto the front foot and chips it over extra cover before scampering across for three
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal waits in his crease and taps it down the ground towards mid off
full and slanted into middle and leg stump. Jaiswal seems to fall over a touch but somehow manages to flick it powerfully past mid wicket for four!
full delivery angled into middle and off stump. Buttler presses half forward and pokes it towards mid on
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Buttler gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side
length delivery outside off stump that shapes away late. Buttler takes a step down the track and prods it towards mid off
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Jaiswal comes half forward and turns it into the leg side for one

beats mid off! Length delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal gets onto the front foot and pushes it down the ground. Brook dives to his left at mid off but can't get to it as the ball trickles into the fence
another length delivery that curves down the leg side. Jaiswal does not get bat on it again but this time, manages to get his pads out of the way too. Called a wide!
is there a nick? And has it carried? Full delivery on leg stump that shapes into the batter. Jaiswal seems to miss it as the ball flicks the pad and floats through to Phillips
swing and a miss! Dug into the track outside off stump. Samad swings himself off his feet but can only connect with fresh air. Sort of sums up SRH;s evening too! RR win by 72 runs!
slower delivery on a length on leg stump. Samad lets the ball come to him before swinging it away past short fine leg for four!
four more! In the slot outside off stump. Samad throws the kitchen sink at it and scythes it over backward point for another boundary!
banged into the track. Umran clears his front leg and flat-bats it towards long on. The fielder misfields but Samad declines the opportunity of a second run
what a shot! Umran is on fire! Banged into the track outside off stump. Umran rises with the bounce and clatters it over wide long on! And it is a No ball, oh dear!
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Samad has a hack at it and toe-ends it down the ground for a single
six more! In the slot, and Samad finally clears the fence! He has a swing at it and heaves it over deep square leg for six!
full toss just outside off stump. Umran continues swinging and this time, flays it past extra cover for a couple of runs
massive! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Umran opens up his stance again and smears it over deep mid wicket for six!
shot! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Umran clears his front leg and absolutely crunches it over mid off for four!
yorker on middle and off stump. Umran gets his bat down in time and digs it out towards the bowler
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Umran swings like a rusty gate and misses the ball by quite some distance
full toss outside off stump. Samad throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep point for a single
full delivery on middle and off stump. Umran comes forward and pushes it towards extra cover

cleans him up! Googly on a length on middle and off stump. Kumar has no clue about it and looks to crash it through the off side. The ball rips back into him, cuts him in half and then disturbs the furniture! RR just two wickets away from victory now!
full delivery just outside off stump. Kumar has a massive swish at it but only gets an inside edge that pops up off his boot towards the bowler
slowed up on a length on middle and leg stump. Kumar goes back and nudges it between long on and deep mid wicket for a brace
length delivery fired into leg stump. Samad comes down the track and works it into the on side for just another single
slow and on a back of a length outside off stump. Samad gives it everything he has but still does not make contact
slower delivery dug into the track on off stump. Samad gets up on his toes and clogs it towards deep mid wicket for a single
excellent yorker just outside off stump. Samad picks it up a little late and can't get his bat down in time. Just misses off stump too!
slower delivery on a length on middle and leg stump. Kumar dabs it towards backward point for one
back of a length delivery on off stump that zips through. Kumar throws his hands at it but is too late on the stroke, and is beaten
full delivery on leg stump. Samad lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads towards deep square leg
short outside off stump. Samad looks to tonk it over cow corner but only connects with fresh air
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Samad comes forward and eases it into the leg side for one more run
at the stumps again. Kumar works it into the leg side for a single
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Kumar pats it gently back to the bowler

tossed up on a length outside off stump. Kumar has a fish at it and misses. Samson whips off the bails and the square leg umpire, possibly out of habit, refers it upstairs. As is protocol, we go through the entire process. Nothing on Ultra Edge, and Kumar's back foot has not moved an inch out of the crease. But the third umpire, for some reason, wants to have multiple looks at it from different angles before coming to the conclusion that almost everyone else arrived at - that Kumar is safe.
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Samad knocks it down the ground and collects another single
length delivery on middle and off stump. Kumar goes back and drops the ball into the off side for a quick single
full toss on middle and leg stump. Kumar prods it towards mid wicket and gets across to the other end
short and wide outside off stump. Samad jumps up onto his toes and cuts it towards deep cover point for a single
yorker that slides just inside the tramlines on the off side. Samad throws his hands at it but only connects with fresh air
back of a length delivery on off stump. Samad has a swish at it and gets a thick inside edge that pings into the thigh pad
full toss just outside off stump. Samad drills it straight to the fielder at mid off
very full delivery outside off stump. Samad comes forward and drives it past extra cover for a couple of runs

stumped by a mile! Flighted up nicely on a length outside off stump. Rashid hares down the track but is nowhere close to the pitch of the ball. He has a swish anyway but misses the ball by quite some distance as it rips past the outside edge. Samson does the rest behind the stumps, and SRH are seven down now!
length delivery down the leg side. Rashid gets into position and paddles it towards short fine leg
tossed up on a length on leg stump. Rashid advances and nurdles it into the leg side for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery on off stump. Rashid hangs back and cuts it towards deep cover point for a brace
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Samad goes back and knocks it down the ground for one more run
full delivery on leg stump. Rashid takes a step down the track and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rashid gets onto the back foot and eases it towards deep cover point for one
full delivery on off stump. Samad plants his front foot and drives it back past the bowler for just another single
length delivery outside off stump. Rashid stands tall and punches it into the off side for a single
Rashid punishes Saini! Full toss on leg stump and Rashid takes full toll! He plants his front foot and shovels it past deep mid wicket for four!
oh dear! High full toss on off stump. Samad is taken aback by it and hacks it away into the leg side. Called a No ball, though, meaning that Rashid will have a Free hit now
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Rashid is late on his cut and ends up jabbing it down to third man for a single. Looks like Saini has overstepped, though...
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Rashid dangles his bat and dabs it towards the keeper
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump that nips back. Samad is caught on the crease and plays all over it as the ball smashes into the pads. Saini appeals but the umpire is unmoved
right out of the screws! Flighted into the slot outside off stump. Rashid dances down the track, swings through the line and thumps it over the bowler's head!
carrom ball that goes wrong and is fired down the leg side. Rashid does not connect with his paddle as the umpire indulges in some more exercise
length delivery on middle and off stump. Rashid comes half forward and taps it gently towards mid wicket
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rashid has a nibble at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
full delivery down the leg side. Samad helps it behind square on the leg side for a single
back of a length delivery down the leg side. Samad does not get any bat on it as the umpire calls it a wide
carrom ball on a length outside off stump. Samad opts to stay back before patting it towards the bowler
full delivery just outside off stump. Samad gets down on one knee and heaves it towards long on. Parag eats up ground to his right and prevents the boundary!

holes out to long off! Flighted devilishly on a full length on off stump. Mayank looks to smash it into next week but is beaten in the flight. Like Phillips, he has to reach out for it and toe-ends it miles up into the air towards long off. Buttler settles under it and completes the catch comfortably!
length delivery on middle and off stump. Samad sits back in his crease and punches it towards deep mid wicket
full delivery outside off stump. Samad lunges forward and blocks it towards extra cover
angled into the stumps. Mayank turns it into the on side and collects another single
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Samad eases it down the ground for a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Mayank goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket for a single
length delivery on middle and off stump that holds its line. Samad closes the bat face a little early and gets a slight leading edge into the off side
length delivery on middle and off stump. Samad hangs back and pokes it towards short mid wicket
full and at the stumps. Defended into the off side by Samad

straight to cover! Looped up on a full length outside off stump, and Phillips' eyes light up. He drives at it but is always reaching out for the ball. In the end, he gets it off the toe end and offers a simple catch to Asif!
length delivery outside off stump. Mayank gets across his stumps and knocks it down the ground for one
length delivery on leg stump. Phillips goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Phillips uses the pace and glances it down to fine leg for a single
breaks the shackles! Dug into the track outside off stump. Phillips rocks onto the back foot and heaves it over deep backward square leg for six!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Phillips gets up on his toes and defends it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery on off stump that darts back into Phillips and cuts him in half. He does not get bat on it but cops a blow on the thigh pad

straight up and taken by Hetmyer! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump that climbs onto Sundar. He has a hack across the line but because the ball gets big on him, he can only spoon it towards Hetmyer at extra cover! SRH in all sorts of trouble now!
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Mayank walks across his stumps and half-sweeps it towards deep backward square leg
length delivery on leg stump. Sundar does not have a lot of room to work with and pokes it towards mid wicket
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Mayank punches it towards backward point. Jaiswal brings out the dive but can't prevent the single
thigh-high full toss speared down the leg side. Mayank does not get any bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Sundar lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his hips towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Sundar gets up on his toes and defends it down the ground
length delivery outside off stump. Sundar presses half forward and jabs it towards backward point
length delivery on leg stump. Mayank helps it down to the fielder at fine leg for a single

knocks him over! Back of a length delivery on middle and off stump that skids through. Brook tries to cut it but does not have any room to work with. It sneaks past the bat and then crashes into the stumps! Brook's troubled stay comes to an end, and SRH sink further in trouble!
tossed up on a full length on leg stump. Brook comes down the track and pokes it towards long off for a couple of runs
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Mayank stretches forward and pushes it towards mid wicket for one more run
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Brook lunges forward and flicks it towards deep mid wicket for just another single
back of a length delivery on off stump. Brook goes back and stabs it into the off side
flat and full on middle and leg stump. Brook jams it off the inside edge into his pads
gets it away! Length delivery just outside off stump. Mayank shuffles across his stumps and paddles it past short fine leg for a much-needed boundary!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that spins back. Mayank can only dab it towards backward point
angled into the stumps. Brook knocks it down the ground for a single
carrom ball on a length on leg stump. Brook pushes it into the gap on the leg side again and collects a couple of runs
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Brook nudges it into the vast real estate on the leg side and scampers across for a brace
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Mayank goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket for a single
full delivery on middle and off stump. Mayank tips it down the ground and hares across to the other end
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Brook runs it down to third man and canters across to the other end
full delivery on middle and leg stump that shapes into Brook. His bat face closes upon contact and he can only drive it straight to mid on
full delivery just outside off stump. Brook gets a half stride forward and pokes it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery angled across the batter outside off stump. Brook takes a step down the track before opting to shoulder arms
back of a length delivery on off stump. Mayank dabs it towards deep backward point and collects a single
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Brook tries to create room for himself but fails to do as, missing his attempted cut stroke altogether
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Brook is cramped for room and can only defend into the off side
slower bumper outside off stump. Mayank is a little early into the stroke and drags it towards mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Mayank gets onto the back foot and blocks it back to the bowler
shot! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Mayank gives himself a bit of room and flat-bats it over the bowler's head!
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump that bounces a tad extra. Mayank goes back and plonks it into the off side
length delivery on middle and off stump that curves in late. Brook comes half forward and defends into the off side
back of a length delivery on off stump. Brook gets behind the line of the ball and meets it right under his eyes
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Mayank works it towards mid wicket and saunters across to the other end
lovely! Length outside off stump and Mayank capitalizes! He springs forward, throws his hands at it and flays it over extra cover for four!
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Mayank hops up onto his toes and drops it towards backward point
full delivery outside off stump. Mayank lunges forward and laces his cover drive. He can't beat the fielder at extra cover, though
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Brook gets on top of the bounce and dabs it towards backward point

was there a nick? Back of a length delivery on off stump that nips back and hurries onto Brook. He has a swipe at it but is late on the stroke as the ball kisses the thigh pad and flies through to Samson. The keeper gathers well but with no bat involved, that is immaterial
gets off the mark in style! Slower delivery that lands right in the slot outside off stump. Brook plants his front foot and effortlessly lifts it over mid off for four!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Brook goes back and punches it towards mid wicket
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Mayank hops up onto his toes again and fends it into the leg side for a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Mayank gets up on his toes and glances it down to fine leg for a couple of runs
full delivery that starts on leg stump and swings further down. Brook does not get bat on it as Samson dives to his left to rein it in. Not called a wide either

taken excellent at slip! Full delivery just outside off stump. Tripathi takes a step down the track, and opens his bat face, almost guiding it towards Holder, who is stationed at a wide slip. Holder flings himself to his left and holds onto a spectacular catch! But hang on....Tripathi has reviewed this one, saying that he has not nicked it at all. Replays, though, only confirm what we saw first time out. Tripathi has absolutely smashed it, and he now has to walk back!
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Tripathi gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side

cleans him up with an absolute peach! Sizzling yorker that seems to start on middle and leg stump before swerving away at the last moment. Abhishek is completely flummoxed by it and can't lay bat on it as the ball flattens off stump! What a special delivery!
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Abhishek comes half forward and stabs it down the ground towards mid on
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that shapes away. Abhishek gets behind the line of the ball and presents the full face of the bat
